brief.scope: Returned four-corner pressure history only; fitted leak and imbalance inferences are not manufacturer readings.

coldReview.title: Private cold tire checks
coldReview.description: Compare your own cold gauge readings, separately from the vehicle’s TPMS chart. Nothing is sent outside TeslaSync.
coldReview.vehicle: Select a vehicle in the workspace picker to record cold checks.
coldReview.signIn: This private review requires verified sign-in.
coldReview.offline: Reconnect to review your saved cold checks.
coldReview.off: Off. Save a confirmed cold gauge check to start an independent private series.
coldReview.waiting: No current repeated drift. Saved checks: {{checks}}. We need at least five comparable checks spanning seven days or more.
coldReview.consent: I used the same gauge on all four tires before driving, with the tires cold and no wheel rotation or pressure adjustment since the previous check. Compare these readings privately on this server.
coldReview.invalid: Enter a reading time in the past 30 days, an ambient temperature and four valid gauge readings.
coldReview.removeMessage: Delete these private gauge readings and their decision? Vehicle telemetry and warnings are not changed. Start over after a rotation or pressure adjustment.
coldReview.conflict: The series changed, or this reading is less than 18 hours after the last one. Check the last entry before saving again.
coldReview.failure: Could not change your private series. Refresh and verify your sign-in and vehicle.
coldReview.cardSummary: {{wheel}} fell by at least {{drop}} relative to the other tires across {{checks}} comparable cold checks.
coldReview.cardBasis: You entered cold gauge readings from {{start}} to {{end}}. The latest reading on this tire was {{pressure}}.
coldReview.cardLimit: Check it cold with a gauge and follow the vehicle’s own guidance. This pattern does not diagnose a leak, set a target pressure, or replace a vehicle warning.

tireDifferentialDrift.title: Tire differential drift
tireDifferentialDrift.subtitle: Removes the four-tire common mode at every sample, so what remains is how each corner moves relative to its peers — an inference, not a manufacturer reading
tireDifferentialDrift.daysToThresholdHint: projected from the fitted trend, evidence-gated
tireDifferentialDrift.noData: No usable four-corner TPMS history yet. Each row needs a plausible reading on all four tires to compute the common-mode median.
tireDifferentialDrift.noDrift: At least two usable four-corner samples at distinct times are needed to fit a drift rate.
tireDifferentialDrift.residualTimelineHint: Each corner's deviation from the four-tire median at every sample — shared weather swings cancel out, leaving only relative drift
tireDifferentialDrift.residualTimelineAria: Line chart of four tire-corner pressure residuals against the common-mode median over time
tireDifferentialDrift.slopeRankingHint: Theil-Sen slope of each corner's residual, per day — negative means losing pressure relative to the group
tireDifferentialDrift.slopeRankingAria: Bar chart of the fitted residual drift rate per day for each tire corner
tireDifferentialDrift.noReading: The reading appears once at least one usable four-corner sample has been analyzed.
